title: 第9章 宅基地第10章 咱家天大的事
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
看苏灿话说到这个份上，老支书点了头：“行，这些东西叔收下了，战东媳妇，你有什么事儘管说。只要是我能帮上的，我一定帮！”
苏灿点点头，“是这样的，战东的腿必须得赶紧送到医院治疗，我准备今天下午麻烦周大爷跑一趟，用他的马车把战东送到县城去。
这样我就得在县城里多待几天，您看今天刚分了家，我们那个房子就一间，今天我想跟您开个口，划个宅基地，等战东回来后，我准备盖几间房子，家里这么多人总不能一直挤在一间屋里。您说是不是？”
周长亭听她的话忍不住竖了个大拇指：“侄媳妇，这事没问题。你看咱们村哪块地方，叔就划给你。”
“周叔，我今天才来咱们村，对这里也不熟悉。您给出个主意唄。”
周长亭皱著眉头正思考，周青山开口道：“爹，其实他们现在住的那个地方就挺好的，进出方便，也不用爬坡。”
周长亭听儿子的话拍了下桌子：“侄媳妇，青山说的没错，你们现在住的那个地方就很好。以前是个场院，后来四周盖了房子，今天战东搬过去之后就没人用那儿了。你看草都长的一人多高了。再说那个地方也大，能划六间房子，前面的院子也不小。绝对是个好地方。”
“好，那就太谢谢周叔了。”
“你看你这孩子，咋光说谢谢呢。以后什么地方需要帮忙的，你过来说一声就行。你不知道，我们家青山和战东那可是一起穿开襠裤长大的，关係好著呢。”
周青山接过话去：“嫂子以后有什么事，儘管找我就行。”
苏灿笑笑，“我还真有事想请你帮个忙。”
“嫂子你说吧，什么事？”
苏灿接著道：“下午我送战东去县医院，今天分家的那些东西就没人看著了，我想请青山兄弟晚上去那里睡几晚上，帮我们照看一下孩子和家里的东西。”
“这点小事没问题，你就放心吧。今天吃了晚饭我就过去。”
苏灿又看向李淑兰：“婶子，这只老母鸡是今天分家分到的，我去医院里就没办法养著了。想把这只老母鸡暂时放您这里养几天。下的鸡蛋您留著吃就行，您看行吗？”
家是分好了，但是这些分到的东西她必须得守住。
这话把李淑兰逗乐了：“婶子顺手的事，放心吧，肯定给你照顾的好好的。”
农村人很多都是热心肠，这种事情顺手就能做。
周青山过来带著小傢伙去了鸡栏，把那只老母鸡给放进了鸡窝里。
苏灿又看著周长亭道：“叔，如果我们家盖新房子的话，大约得需要多少钱？”

她得做到心中有数，才知道接下来该怎么办。
周长亭想了想道：“那要看你先盖几间了，是一下子把六间全都盖起来吗？那可能要的多一些。”
“先盖四间吧。”
现在正是缺钱的时候，她得量力而行。
“咱们村西面有座石头山，村子里盖房子都是去那里起石头，四间房的话两百块应该是没什么问题的。”
旁边的李淑兰插进话来：“村南头张庆生家盖四间房子，手里就五十块钱。不过他的亲戚帮衬的多，给送菜的送菜，送粮食的送粮食。连人都来了好几口子呢，这些省了他不少钱。”
周长亭跟著点点头：“反正两百块钱保证让你把房子盖起来，要是省著点一百五应该也差不多。”
苏灿起身道：“行，那我就心里有数了。叔，婶子，你们赶紧吃饭吧，我得回去给他们做饭吃。孩子们今天早上就没吃，全都饿著肚子呢。”
李淑兰拦住她道：“侄媳妇，我们也不留你了。这样，你跟我去后面菜园里摘点菜拿著。”
content_en:
Seeing that Su Can said this, the old branch secretary nodded: "Okay, uncle will accept these things. Zhan Dong's wife, if you have anything to say, just tell me. As long as I can help, I will definitely help!"
Su Can nodded, "That's right, Zhan Dong's leg must be sent to the hospital for treatment immediately. I'm going to ask Uncle Zhou to make a trip this afternoon and use his carriage to take Zhan Dong to the county seat.
This will force me to stay in the county town for a few more days. You see, we have just divided our family today, and our house only has one room. Today I want to open a conversation with you and designate a homestead. When Zhan Dong comes back, I plan to build several houses. There are so many people in the family who cannot be crowded into one house all the time. Do you think so? "
Zhou Changting couldn't help but give a thumbs up after hearing her words: "Niece-in-law, this is no problem. If you look at any part of our village, I will give it to you."
"Uncle Zhou, I just came to our village today and I am not familiar with it. Please give me an idea."
Zhou Changting frowned and was thinking, when Zhou Qingshan said: "Dad, actually the place they live in now is quite nice. It's easy to get in and out, and there's no need to climb a hill."
Zhou Changting slapped the table after listening to his son's words: "Niece, Qingshan is right, the place you live in now is very good. It used to be a farmyard, and then houses were built around it. After Zhan Dong moved there today, no one has used it. You see, the grass has grown as tall as one person. Besides, the place is also big, it can be divided into six houses, and the yard in front is not small. It is definitely a good place."
"Okay, thank you very much, Uncle Zhou."
"Look at you kid, why are you just saying thank you? If you need help in the future, just come and say it. You don't know, our Qingshan and Zhan Dongna grew up wearing crotchless pants together, so we have a good relationship."
Zhou Qingshan took over: "Sister-in-law, if anything happens in the future, just come to me."
Su Can smiled and said, "I really have something to ask you for a favor."
"Sister-in-law, tell me, what's the matter?"
Su Can continued: "I will send Zhan Dong to the county hospital in the afternoon. No one will look at the things that were separated today. I would like to ask Brother Qingshan to sleep there for a few nights and help us take care of the children and things at home."
"This little thing is no problem, don't worry. I'll go over after dinner today."
Su Can looked at Li Shulan again: "Aunt, this old hen was given to the family today. I can't keep it after I go to the hospital. I want to leave this old hen with you temporarily for a few days. You can keep the eggs for eating. Do you think that's okay?"
The family was divided, but she had to keep the things she had been given.
These words made Li Shulan amused: "Auntie, don't worry, I will take good care of you."
Many rural people are warm-hearted and can easily do this kind of thing.
Zhou Qingshan came over and took the little guy to the chicken coop and put the old hen into the chicken coop.
Su Can looked at Zhou Changting and said, "Uncle, if our family builds a new house, how much will it cost?"
She had to know what to do next.
Zhou Changting thought for a while and said, "It depends on how many rooms you build first. Do you want to build all six rooms at once? That may require more."
"Let's build four rooms first."
Now is the time when she is short of money, so she has to do what she can.
"There is a stone mountain to the west of our village. People in the village use stone to build houses there. For four rooms, two hundred yuan should be no problem."
Li Shulan, who was standing next to him, interjected: "Zhang Qingsheng's family in the south of the village built four houses with only fifty yuan. However, his relatives helped a lot, delivering food to the vegetable delivery people and food to the food delivery people. Several people came to the house, which saved him a lot of money."
Zhou Changting nodded: "Anyway, two hundred yuan is guaranteed to let you build a house. If you save a few hundred and fifty yuan, it should be about the same."
Su Can stood up and said: "Okay, then I know what to do. Uncle, aunt, you hurry up and eat. I have to go back and cook for them. The children haven't eaten this morning and are all hungry. "
Li Shulan stopped her and said, "Niece-in-law, we won't keep you here either. In this case, you and I will go to the vegetable garden behind to pick some vegetables. "
